# openprovider Provider

The OpenProvider provider manages domains in Openprovider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    openprovider = {
      source  = "charpand/openprovider"
      version = ">= 0.1.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "openprovider" {
  username = var.openprovider_username
  password = var.openprovider_password
}
```

## Authentication

The provider requires `username` and `password` configuration.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) Root URL of the OpenProvider API. Falls back to the `OPENPROVIDER_BASE_URL` environment variable, and to the production API when neither is set.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) OpenProvider password. Falls back to the `OPENPROVIDER_PASSWORD` environment variable.
- `username` (String) OpenProvider username. Falls back to the `OPENPROVIDER_USERNAME` environment variable.
